notes: Coverage status of tests the frozen formal text sets for itself. Each item below is quoted from the frozen chapter; the state recorded against it is a statement about what the research panels carry, not a new fact about any company. No item here is promoted into a chapter and the formal reopen gate is unchanged: this layer records status, never conclusions. Corrected 2026-10-26: lease/payment support is not residual-value guarantee; missing loss waterfall is not cured by collateral valuation; secondary-asset liquidity is not inherently post-default.

states.carried: a named facility/support form in the tracked panel directly evidences at least one instance of the exact required variable; this is not marketwide completeness
states.partly observable: some inputs are recorded but an essential contractual or matched-denominator component is missing
states.not disclosed: the tracked panels do not supply a matched disclosure for this exact variable; this does not establish that a market or contract cannot exist
states.not yet observed: the defined event has not occurred or been recorded for a borrower in the tracked cohort; this is an event-status observation, not a permanent unobservability theorem

register_note: The frozen corpus was searched in both editions for enumerated evidence-requirement checklists of the form 'a defensible X would require evidence on: [list]'. Ch23 §1B is the only one found; a search of the English edition for 'would require evidence on / would need evidence / requires evidence of' and of the Chinese edition for the corresponding 需要证据 / 需要看到 forms returns this checklist and one non-enumerated rule at Ch21. The register therefore has one entry, and it is stated as such rather than presented as a survey. If a later reading finds a second enumerated checklist, it is added here as another gate and the layer's §0 scope is unchanged.

gates.test: whether the current AI buildout can be classified as a replay of the telecom bubble or the 2008 securitization cycle
gates.rule: Without those contract-level variables, the analogy remains a research heuristic, not a formal report conclusion.
gates.rule_zh: 如果这些 contract-level 变量没有公开，历史类比只能作为研究启发（research heuristic），不能升级成正式结论。

items.detail: Debt principal, coupon, maturity, collateral and non-recourse status are carried per facility. The asset-side valuation that an LTV needs is not disclosed by any facility in the panel, so the ratio itself cannot be formed from the disclosures tracked here.

A DSCR covenant of 1.15x plus a minimum-liquidity covenant (Nebius), disclosed DDTL covenant compliance (CoreWeave), and recourse recorded as such — DDTL 4.0 is largely non-recourse and several facilities sit in SPVs.

Carried as a distinct support form rather than as a footnote to revenue: take-or-pay colocation structures and customer prepayment / minimum payment, with the contracted cash flow identified as what supports debtability.

04D §11C.3 records lease/payment and completion guarantees and caps, not a contractual residual-value floor or repurchase obligation on named collateral. These categories cannot be promoted to this checklist item. No matched residual-value/repurchase term is established by the tracked panel.

Instrument seniority is recorded, but actual priority-of-payments and intercreditor waterfall terms and tranche loss allocation are not. Even a facility-matched asset valuation alone cannot disclose contractual senior/junior priority.

Drawn state, pricing, covenant and rollover are refreshed, and two refinancing actions are observed rather than assumed: Core Scientific's March-2026 term loan repaid and replaced by the 2031 notes, and Applied Digital's bridge refinanced into the 2031 notes after year-end.

No default/restructuring event is recorded for a borrower in the tracked panel as of this observation. Such an event cannot be marked as occurred in advance; historical observations elsewhere and pre-event rights are still analytically possible. This absence is not a permanent proof that the historical analogy is untestable.

items.item: transferability and secondary-market liquidity of the underlying assets
items.detail: The existing panels lack facility-collateral-matched realized transaction prices, depth/spreads, transfer restrictions or distressed recoveries. Used-GPU/server resale observations may exist ex ante, so an unobservable-in-principle claim is invalid. Compute-price contracts or indices are not evidence of physical collateral resale liquidity.
